(Millenia was setting all the stored map variables to 0, naughty succubus!)[/p][p align="start"]- Fixed the skill reset function, it should now add and missing skills to party members correctly.[/p][p align="start"]- Removed chest containing water flask from the Salolo desert. It was there by mistake and was not supposed to be obtained there, it was breaking the story flow in places.[/p][p align="start"]- Added missing weapons and skills for Guard, Guard Captain and Succubus Queen.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Other Fixes and Tweaks:[/b][/p][p align="start"]- Added all party members to scenes where you are required to gather your party to prevent softlocks. (Going to the world map should hopefully clear up the issue)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Known Issues:[/b][/p][p][b](Issues to be fixed)[/b][/p][p align="start"]- The card minigame can't be controlled properly on mobile. (Working on a fix, sorry about this one)[/p][p align="start"]- Quest log isn't tracking correctly (visual bug, quest can still progress)[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Much love,[/p][p align="start"]MGGEDev[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0g - Lots of Softlock Fixes and Other Fixes
notes.content:

Thank you so much for your support and sorry about many of these launch bugs!

[b]Changes:

- Fixed Guards in the guard house still being visible after you defeat them
- Fixed Millenia's name being shown instead of Reyna's during some of the guard house dialogue

- Fixed random character being visible in the first shrine at Nyuuville (we have plans for them but accidentally made them visible)

- There seems to be some issues with the card minigame controls on android, the minigame should at least be playable now *more fixes needed*

Is your party ready for what is to come?[/p][p]This update includes a massive 5 new h-scenes and 4 new party members![/p][p]Starting a new save is recommended for the best experience due to the number of changes and balance tweaks but old saves will still function.[/p][p]Find the full changelog below.[/p][h1][b]== 1.0 Changelog Overview ==[/b][/h1][list][*][p]The story continues with a bunch of new locations to visit and story content. notes.title: 1.0 Release Date - Monster Girl Invasion RPG Part 1
notes.content:
Hello Monster Girl Lovers!

[b]1.0 is coming.
[/b]
[h2]Part one of Monster Girl Invasion RPG will finally be leaving early access and hitting 1.0 on July 18th.[/h2]

You can look forward to a multitude of new features and content. New monster girls in the roster, new scenes and more!

In the post-1.0 updates, we'd like to expand the availability of non-defeat h-scenes and ones obtained by other means.

You can find some of the New Additions and Changes below, however this is still yet to be changed as development continues:

[b][h2]New Content:
[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] We'll be adding 3 new monster girls to battle and recruit as well as a scene for the Goldeka Queen and for one of the Maids in the Party inn. That's 5 new h-scenes in total!
[*] Every recruitable character in the game has been given at least 20-30 skills they can learn via level ups. Skill variety has been widely increased.
[*] The story also continues. What will you discover in the new areas and what secrets does the Capital city hold?
[*] The party inn is being expanded with new areas to not only add more flair and more areas for monster girls to live, but also to add new ways to strengthen your party.
[*] There are over 20 new items and equipment that have been added to various points of the game.
[*] More locked chests have been added in various places around the world to make lockpicks more worthwhile.
[/list]
There is also much more yet to be announced, we don't want to reveal everything just yet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/ebd99b512cdafd07e7782230b3f5d95c7637e155.png[/img]
Punished By a Soldier Girl

[b][h2]Upgrades, Changes and Fixes
[/h2][/b]
We've made a huge number of tweaks, fixes and other bits of polish across the board, including but not limited to:

[list]
[*] Lots of story dialogue and other dialogue fixes, tweaks and revisions to keep the story smooth and coherent.
[*] More dialogue added to various places, especially after the player has finished certain events.  For example, after finding the elf-cowgirl hybrid at the lab, if you go back to Nyuuville and speak to the rancher, you can get some special dialogue.
[*] Some cutscenes have been reworked to either have a bit more life so the characters aren't just standing around, or to have character busts display on the screen.
[*] You can now choose the appearance for Monster Girls that have multiple forms, so that your favourite appearance is in the party.
[*] Lots of balance tweaks across the board.
[*] Stat Curves of all Characters have been tweaked significantly to optimise them in a way that make sense for their class.
[*] Many, many bug fixes and other tweaks.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/cd7b53efbbe8cadb96287b9cc549cee38b416926.png[/img]
The Dojo is one of the new Party Inn areas.

[b][h2]Closing Statement:
[/h2][/b]
This is just some of what is to come for the 1.0 release. The changelog will likely be much bigger when the time comes.

[b]However, this is NOT the end for part 1 of the game!
[/b]
[b]Part 1 will still receive free content updates before and after the release of part 2. The first stop is the mysterious snowy area to the north of the world map![/b]

We'll be also going back and adding new content, fixes and tweaks to Part 1 as the world of Monster Girl Invasion RPG develops further when creating Part 2. In the end, it'll all be merged into one massive monster girl filled RPG!

We can' t wait to get it into your hands, we are sure it will be worth the wait!

Much Love,

MGGEDev

notes.title: Updates to the Save Import/Export System
notes.content:
Hello Monster Girl Lovers!

We're back again with more updates for Monster Girl Invasion RPG.

[b]Import/Export Your Saves!
[/b]
We've made some extensive upgrades to the save import/export system so that it will work on mobile and browser too. You can now import and export your saves on any platform!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/0e1ceeeb4e09f301e8d705293b6c207f6c126766.png[/img]

[b]Import/Export System Changes:
[/b]
[list]
[*] A nice new UI for the import/export system.
[*] See which slots are available and already taken, choose a slot to import the save to and also the ability to overwrite existing saves.
[*] More checks and safety steps to make sure things don't get broken.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/c8971377276f6988d5215e81b76867521775b8b5.png[/img]

[b]Other Changes:
[/b][list]
[*] Fixed some NPC positioning issues that could cause players to get stuck in some cases. This was due to the NPC location not being saved correctly. We now have additional checks and move the NPC to where they should be if they are in the wrong place.
[/list]

Please enjoy, see you soon with more updates!

Much Love,

MGGEDev

notes.title: Update V5g - New Save Import and Export System
notes.content:
Hello Monster girl lovers!

We've updated the game today with a new save import and export system! You can see the shiny new buttons on the title screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/ce9f80513cc2e7f8abddda9942bbe2e552fec2da.png[/img]

This is to make it easier for those who want to transfer their demo saves over to the full game or transfer their saves to other platform versions of the game.

Simply click the export save button and input which save file you would like to export.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/9d01c82cf07be87cdba7db3cc3dec1394d9f0635.png[/img]

The save data will then be copied to your clipboard. Next click the import save button and paste the save data into the box.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/27e013c96313bdf065def1c1f404278ccc40e007.png[/img]

Once you press okay, the save data will be imported and you can load it to continue playing your save.

This is much easier than hunting down the save files on your system and lets you transfer saves between systems and even share them with each other more easily!

This also allows for save data from the newgrounds web demo to be extracted.

Much Love,

MGGEDev

notes.title: Your Votes Are In! Here’s What’s Coming Next!
notes.content:
Hello Monster Girl Lovers!

After our last update in January about the game’s future, I’m back with an exciting new update on what’s coming next!

[b]The Poll Results:
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/13d1a404220fc010206521634673b9c6f6820c4b.png[/img]

Thanks to everyone who voted and shared their thoughts! The community has spoken, and the game will now be split into multiple parts. To reflect this, we’ve already updated the game’s title on storefronts.

Most importantly, I want to sincerely thank each of you for your support, encouragement, and kind messages. This project wouldn’t be possible without you!

[b]What Happens Next?
[/b]
We’ll continue working on the game as normal until we have finished the current storyline in part 1, added a significant amount of polish and also more side content and other fun things.

We want to make sure everything is fully wrapped up.

There will be one more major content update which will conclude part one. This update will include the following:

[list]
[*] 4 new monster girls that are fightable and recruitable
[*] More side content and fleshing out of the world
[*] More learnable Skills for all characters
[*] More Equipment and Items with unique effects
[*] Many bug fixes and optimisations
[/list]

There will be smaller updates and inevitable bug fix patches after this.

[b]When Is The Next Major Update?
[/b]
It’ll hopefully be ready around March or April.

[b]About Pricing
[/b]
I want to make sure the price remains fair. 

[list]
[*] Future parts will not be more expensive than Part 1.
[*] If you own Part 1, you can get other parts with a discounted steam bundle.
[*] Once all parts are complete, we’ll merge them into a Definitive Edition, you’ll get this for free if you own all parts.
[/list]

[b]About Saved Data
[/b]
[list]
[*] Your save data from Part 1 will carry over into Part 2, so you can continue your journey without losing progress.
[*] New players will be able to start fresh with an intro sequence & custom choices to shape their party and inventory.
[/list]

[b]Overall Game Upgrades[/b]

With the way things are being approached for the parts system, any future updates that are made to future parts can be applied to previous parts retroactively.

So for example if we make some sweeping optimisations and changes to the game in part 2, those things will also apply to part 1.

We can even go back and touch up/add things to old areas in part 2 and have those changes reflected into part 1.

This means that we can still maintain and add new things to part 1 as we go along. It isn’t the end of updates for part 1.

Any changes that are made moving forward can benefit all previous parts.

[b]Kickstarter Backers For Part 1
[/b]
All original kickstarter backers for part 1 will get all future parts for free as we do not want to take away from them what was originally promised during the campaign.

[b]Kickstarter For Part 2
[/b]
Once part 1 is completed, there are plans to do a kickstarter for part 2. This is a great opportunity for those that missed the original campaign to get their own custom character and scenes into the game!

This will allow for appropriate funds to be raised to get part 2 fully funded for completion.

Part 1 was a learning experience, and we’ve gained valuable insights into budgeting and development. With Part 2, we can plan ahead more effectively to ensure a smooth development process with confidence.

[b]Contents of Each Part
[/b]
The aim is to have each part contain roughly the same amount of content but never less. All future parts will have around the same amount of characters, side content and story time as part 1 (once completed).

So you can look forward to around 25 new monster girls for each new part!

Once the game and all parts are fully complete, we hope to have over 100 different monster girls. Gotta…Cure them all?

[b]A Thank You & A Look Forward
[/b]
Finally, I want to take a moment to sincerely thank [b]every single player[/b] who has supported this game. Your passion, feedback, and encouragement mean the world to me.

I also want to acknowledge that this wasn’t the original plan, and I deeply appreciate your understanding as we move forward in a way that ensures the game reaches its full potential.

This[b] isn’t[/b] a cash grab decision, just a solo dev who underestimated how much work and funding would be needed to make the game as great as it deserves to be. Thanks to all of you, I won’t give up!

Much love,


MGGEDev

notes.title: [Important Poll] Regarding the Future of Monster Girl Invasion RPG
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Happy new year to you all!

I'm glad for all your support so far. It has been so humbling and the best part of my entire life to make this game with you all.

It has been a little while since the last update, sorry about that.

I really wish I had better news to give you all. Especially after almost 3 years in development.

The game is still going, just a lot slower than I'd like. The game isn't making enough money to pay our wonderful artists consistently right now, so I've been busy doing some work on the side to try and keep things moving.

The game is not dead, nor will it be dying. Things are unfortunately just not progressing as fast as they could if the game was more popular. We simply do not have the funding that some other games have.

However, with the costs of development, especially when it comes to the art. I simply cannot afford it anymore. Hence why things have become a bit of a crawl since the last update.

All of the money I've been making has been getting re-invested into the game in the form of art commissions but at this point I've dipped into my pockets so far that it is not often that I can afford the cost of art commissions and put food on the table for my wife at the same time. The game isn't making enough money.

Honestly, I'm starting to wonder whether it is worth rounding off and polishing this part of the game as best as possible and releasing "part 2, part 3" as separate games that lets you import your saved data and continue. I know a lot of games release in episodes like that, especially in the adult space. I always hated that method of doing things, but being in the situation I'm in now, I think I understand why they might do it.

However, I'm worried such a thing could upset a lot of fans or existing buyers of the game. I don't want anyone to think this game is a cash grab. I pretty much made no profit on this game with all the costs involved.

If people were open to the idea of splitting the game into parts. (With the current part ending after the next big content update). We'd be able to take another stab at a kickstarter for "part 2" and raise a lot of funds for our artists that way, basically guaranteeing enough funds to complete part 2 in its entirety and at a much faster speed than things took so far due to having established systems already in place. But it is down to whether people would find that acceptable.

I thought it could be worth a poll at least. So here it is.

I don't want to do anything without the approval of the main community. I'll do what you guys vote for as a majority.

Please feel free to comment with your thoughts too. This post is open to everyone due to the nature of it.

[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/future-of-girl-120825226]The poll can be found here.
[/url]

Kind regards,

MGGEDev

We're back with the first major update of 2024!

[*] Added around 40 new skill animations to go with some of the new skills.
[*] Added a whole bunch of new items and pieces of equipment, 55 to be exact! Some have special features as described below!
[*] Improvised Weapons now each have a unique skill attached to them that can only be used when the weapon is equipped. Using the AP system, you can master the skill by using the weapon in battle and earning enough AP points. Once you've mastered the skill, you can use it without having the weapon equipped!
[*] Added some more little secrets and bits of flavour around the world.
[*] Added some more locked chests in some locations.
[/list]


[b]Fixes and Tweaks:
[/b]
[list]
[*] The Goldeka Card Beasts tournament has been overhauled and fixed. Please try to break it!

[*] Goldeka port can now be re-entered from the boat dock if you decide to dock there or just want to re-enter the city.
[*] Added Goldeka Port to the teleport menu for faster access to the boat spawn location.
[*] More Fixes to TeleStones being able to be used during special scenes which would cause them to break.
[*] Escape Scrolls have been adjusted and fixed in many places, they should work as intended in all dungeon locations now.
[*] Game now correctly shows an icon on the task bar and window.

[/b]
[list]
[*] Story Skips are still disabled as they are not functioning correctly,  after much work, we've made the decision to push the update without this function for the time being. It is far too buggy for us to push out just yet. There is a lot that we need to change in the back end in order to get it working more smoothly. Sorry for the inconvenience.
[*] Actions in the Cheat Room may still cause bugs or strange things to happen during the story. (having certain characters before you are supposed to and etc.) We'll continue to patch it when issues are discovered.

notes.title: New Year Progress Report - Update 5 Inbound!
notes.content:
Hello Monster Girl Lovers!

We're here with our first devlog of the year, sorry for the wait. We hope you all had a wonderful new year!

We'll be adding so much to the game in Update 5, we're so excited to get it done and release it to you all. Whilst we did take a break over the holidays to visit family, we've been tapping away relentlessly so that we can get this next update done. 

We were originally hoping to get it out by the new year but things are taking a bit longer than expected in certain areas. We also decided to change one of the original planned characters, which is currently being re-designed.

We'll be adding 3 new monster girls in Update 5! 

Will you be able to resist them all?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/433b2221e001891b6a175d336236b8df0e69a120.png[/img]

The main story will be continued from the Spooky Mansion, what secrets does it hold? What kind of monsters are lurking in the dark halls?

We have also continued work on the Cheat Room, Story Skips and monster recruitment should be (hopefully) fully functional upon release of Update 5!

With the extra time given to us whilst the new characters are being designed, we have also expanded other parts of the update beyond the original scope!

There has been a lot of feedback relating to lack of skills for certain characters and some players have specifically requested more skills focused on dealing "pleasure" type damage. We're pleased to announce we'll be adding 50+ new skills to the game with update 5! Many of them will be pleasure focused but we're adding a wide range of types. These skills will also come with a huge variety of newly added animations!

With these new skills will also come some new states to go with them, such as the "mounted" state, when a monster girl has jumped on top of you in an attempt to use your body. If you don't escape in time, it'll turn into a "sex" state and she'll begin to drain your life force with her sexual attacks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/35c705e325b04bd4c7a53ce152435c4a77f2d157.png[/img]

We're also expanding upon improvised weapons. Until now, improvised weapons were simply cool or universal weapons that could be used by anyone. Now, with our new system, all improvised weapons will come with a unique skill attached to them. These skills can only be used when the weapon is equipped.  However,  with every battle you win, you'll earn AP points from your enemies. Using the AP points system, you can master the skill by using the weapon in battle and earning enough AP points. Once you've mastered the skill, you can use it without having the weapon equipped!

You'll see the available skill and the AP requirement to master it in the equipment window when you highlight the weapon.

On the back of this new AP system, we're adding a huge amount of new weapons, equipment and also other useful items. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/9ad8d6768b4465b6bcde8561b7e58571fdf99838.png[/img]

There is also a lot of work going into sound effects for the H-Scenes. We are unsure whether we'll finish them in time to include them in the update but, Since the beginning we've wanted to improve them. We're working on implementing a [b]huge [/b]number of new and varied sexual sound effects to expand upon the scenes. Well over 100 files of moaning, slapping and slurping! No more awkward silence and no more weird stock sound effects!

It goes without saying, there will also be numerous bugfixes. We've tackled a large number of longstanding and frustrating bugs such as recruiting not working correctly with a full party, typos, issues with some h-scenes and more!

We're so excited to continue this journey with you all through 2024. Thank you for joining us!

Catch you all soon,

notes.title: October Progress Report Devlog
notes.content:
Hello Monster Girl Lovers!

We're here with a devlog for October, we'll be showing off some of the things we've been preparing for Update 4 which should be coming very soon. The early access test build is expected to be available for patrons by the end of November.

[url=https://www.patreon.com/monstergirlinvasion]Join our patreon[/url] for early access to updates and full CG sets of our monster girls before anyone else!

[b]New Monster Girls:
[/b]
The Ant Girl and Queen Ant will be making their debut to the world of Monster Girl Invasion, found in a cave where they've made their hive, they are sure to be of interest to hardened monster girl hunters. Be careful though, they come in numbers!

Here are some final drafts of the new monster girls:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/897f157c7dca0f6df4e7eed4594dce7f9e4135ce.png[/img]
The Ant Girl

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/3f265e89b183e84df9ab46cea0b44135698a7985.png[/img]
The Queen Ant

The Ant Girls and Queen Ant will become accessible as part of the upcoming story expansions that come along with Update 4. 

We do have a design for the Lamia Queen finalised but it doesn't look as though she'll be done in time for update 4, but she is very much in the works to come soon too!

[b]Cheat Room
[/b]
On the topic of story, we've been having issues for some time with save data becoming incompatible as the game develops and we release new updates, this is due to big changes in the game structure among other things that are hard to keep consistent enough for all saves to stay compatible. This has been frustrating for both us and our players as people have often had to start new saves after making much progress through the game. Many have asked us to add a story skip function.

On the back of this problem, we've decided to implement a "Cheat Room" much in the style of our old favourite games such as the elder scrolls series. Players can access this cheat room and find a variety of functions and tools to boost themselves through the game, skip to certain parts of the story or simply break the game at their leisure.

We expect this new feature to cause many problems due to giving a lot of power to the player to break things but it should eventually turn into something that enables players to freely sandbox the game if they desire. 

Most importantly, it'll have a story skip area that will allow you to skip to certain parts of the story so you don't have to start completely from the beginning every time we have problems with save data.

[b]New Areas
[/b]
There will be some new areas in update 4, including some updates and new areas that are accessible on the world map. They are as follows:

"The North Cave" - This will be the area in which the Ant Girls reside, it also serves as a crossing point to the northern section of the world map. (It is the cave next to the capital that was previously inaccessible).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/76387b868cbfc4d2bf6d18ea937aef8667b427ef.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/b0be0d44ddef428ee2d84d7a1e6c2901563a9b0f.png[/img]



"The Cheat Room" - As mentioned above this is a special room that will be accessed via a special item you can obtain in the beginning of the game. Only intended for those that want to cheat, sandbox or skip parts of the story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/ccb957c99138977932f7bc2a9bad43939082612c.png[/img]

"A Spooky Mansion" - Whilst not fully accessible yet, you can enter the outer courtyard to get a feeling of what we plan for the next updates after update 4. Unfortunately a bit too late for halloween but we want to add a slightly more spooky area with some appropriately spooky monster girls!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/78051a22c34a6d13e8f11a3bd4d375b43333fd5c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/7a3d1006b5de4c75a07b0e022ea5a8f8ceac58a9.png[/img]


The Northern side of the world map has been given some much needed love and preparation for future updates, we plan to utilise this area more moving fowards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/010493c031c85caa6404f963f10b50cb9b17780e.png[/img]

[b]Fixes and Tweaks
[/b]
Based on bug reports and feedback we've had until now, many fixes and tweaks such as fixing broken achievements and adding missing music will also be implemented, a full changelog will be provided along with the update when the time comes.

[b]That's all for now!
[/b]
We hope you enjoy this little delve int our recent developments and we're looking forward to pushing the update out to everyone in due course. This devlog is not fully finalised so there is potential for more to be included when update 4 comes around.

In the meantime, watch this space, we'll let you know when the time comes!

Happy Hunting,


MGGEDEv

notes.title: Monster Girl Invasion RPG - First Alpha Release Now Live!
notes.content:
The time has finally arrived!
It has been a long time coming and we are incredibly nervous to finally be pushing the big button...But...

The first Early Access Alpha version of Monster Girl Invasion RPG is now released!

[u][b]State of the Game:[/b][/u]
The game is effectively still an alpha and does not fully represent our vision for the final version, however we hope it is in a state that is both playable and enjoyable for players!

If you want to play a longer, more fleshed out and polished game, it might be worth waiting for at least a couple of more chapters to be added in updates.

There is at the very least a good couple of hours of gameplay for players who want to collect all current monster girls and view all their scenes. The story is slightly shorter if you simply focus on finishing the first chapter.

We recommend collecting all monster girls in preparation for the new story, quest and location additions to come!

More monster girls and content are coming very soon!

It has been important for us to get something playable into the hands of those that have already supported us so much to reach this point. 
We appreciate all of your support and wanted to prove that we are making something that is worthy of supporting.

We hope this will serve as an example of what more is to come when we eventually reach our 1.0 vision of this game and our Monster Girl world!

Things will very likely be quite different later on in the development of the game, things will be reworked, redone and tweaked. Most importantly, things will be much more fleshed out, content rich and polished!

[u][b]This version of the game currently includes the following features:[/b][/u]

- 9 Monster girls + 1 Human Girl with 1 H-Scene Each (more monsters being worked on!)
- Recruitable monster girls with unique abilities, collect them all!
- Inn hub where player can manage their party and interact with recruited monster girls
- Affection system to get H-Scenes without needing to suffer from game over
- First Chapter of the story is written and implemented
- Various locations to explore and quests to complete
- A variety of items and equipment (more to be added soon, we need more!)
- Many other features!
- Maybe some sneaky bugs yet to be discovered (please let us know if you find any!)

[u][b]Ending Note:[/b][/u]

It has been a long and difficult journey hand crafting this adventure from scratch but it has also been a pleasure to work on it! We really hope that players will be able to enjoy what we have created so far.
We hope this will serve as a decent taster for you to look forward to what comes next for the game, plenty more content, the rest of the story and game upgrades are heavily underway!
Any constructive feedback is welcomed, please reach out to us via your preferred channel, be it via the steam forums, discord or simply sending us a private message or email.
We'll try our best to take all valid feedback into consideration when adjusting and creating the rest of the game.

Thank you again and we hope you enjoy our game,

Kind Regards,

MGGEDev

notes.title: New Music | Devlog 19-01-2022
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

[url=https://www.dropbox.com/s/b5fpg3c3hcpywy5/MGI%20Title%20Loopable%20Done.ogg?dl=0]Main Theme

Work continues on story elements of the game as well as adding and implementing the new monster girls lovingly crafted by our artists. The overall intro to the game story is starting to take form and we are using a new quest log system that will help guide players through the game in case they get lost. It will also help you to differentiate between the main quest and any side quests you may pick up during your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/ae99ef12a7f39f9bfbf4ac18b777dc72025c6034.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/3f4668eb3a9675cb58cddea20de4eb93eb25b4df.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/4a4325e9bce2f71c4544a564bfb1c23c0bdc4644.gif[/img]

One of our design choices is to use minimal dialogue for the main character and instead provide the player with multiple choices during conversations. We believe this allows the player to further immerse and connect with their character, instead of having their character speak on the player's behalf, regardless of what they really want to say.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/bf717848258d6a1fea30bec6fa0d27a9457125f7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/bbf23effab767ef42ca02670a1ec29351f440203.png[/img]

The battle system probably only requires a few more minor tweaks to get it feeling exactly how we want it. Now battles feel punchy and the monster girls feel dangerous enough without being too hard or too easy. The only thing missing is our battle theme, which is currently being composed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/95526e804d740fe8f7a2567934b294fb21a3c131.png[/img]

We are coming very close to reaching a playable state that provides enough content to release it to the players so we hope to be able to make a good announcement for you soon. Until then, we shall continue chipping away at the tasks at hand.

The previously mentioned demo should also be ready soon, we just want to make sure that any major changes or overhauls have been completed before releasing it, otherwise we will also need to consider updating the demo in the future which will eat into development time.

As always, thank you everyone for your support! See you next time!

Hello Everyone and Happy new year!

We hope you had a good time during the holidays!

Here is the first devlog of the year from us. After a short break to spend time with family we are now back in full swing of development 

Our artists never skipped a beat for the entire time and have created so much more beautiful work for our game. 

[b]New Art and Characters:[/b]

Presenting the Rogue Fox Girl and the Hard working Bee Girl! They also have H-Scenes completed, you can get early access to these through [url=https://patreon.com/monstergirlinvasion]patreon[/url], otherwise they will be included in the game on the first release version! [b]Story Progress:[/b]

A lot more story content is being implemented and fleshed out at this point. The intro is really taking shape and feels very playable compared to what we had originally. Our main priority right now is to make it feel polished enough to play through whilst also making sure to provide enough content for the first release. We want to at least be able to provide a decent amount of playing time before updates are required.

[b]Gameplay Progress:
[/b]
Gameplay is in a place we are quite happy with, the core mechanics are working correctly and recruiting monster girls works as intended. Game over scenes and temptation events are also working as expected. The main thing missing at the moment is skill variety and skill balancing during battles, which can hopefully be adjusted without too much time requirement.

We are making a lot of effort to breathe life into the world and give the player NPCs to talk to and places to explore. We also want to include other little minigames or goals that players can pursue at their leisure. Whilst this is primarily an Adult game, it is also a JRPG type game and we want it to really feel like one so that it can still be a fun and viable game outside of the sex scenes. This doesn't mean you'll be forced to grind to see the scenes you want but we want to at least make it fun to go through the game!

[b]Translations:
[/b]
Once we reach the first release build, we intend to have the game localised to Japanese for the Japanese market. We have also been looking into a Chinese translation due to overwhelming demand. We will consider other languages if the demand makes them financially logical to pursue, please let us know if there are any languages beyond English, Chinese and Japanese that you really need!

[b]Release Schedule:
[/b]
We expect to be on track for release as planned. We hope to have a playable build by February whilst rolling out early access as intended in March. Watch this space for a ninja release and a demo, we intend to release asap when we reach a stage where we are confident with opening the game up to players!

notes.title: Latest Devlogs | Art Updates
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have been posting devlogs for a little while in other places but forgot that we can also do this on steam. So here is a big chunk of the most recent updates about the game along with some juicy teasers of what to expect. We have some great art from our artists and are having a great time getting it implemented into the game!

We will be posting a few teasers of the CGs in our devlogs.

Patrons on patreon get exclusive access to preview the original resolution CGs that will be used in the game before release as well as WIP work.

[url=https://patreon.com/monstergirlinvasion]Check out Patreon.[/url]

We already have a few H-Scene CG sets for you to see!

Please find a collection of our previous Devlogs below:

_
[h1]Devlog from 9th December 2021[/h1]
Today we received the latest art from one of our artists. This time it was for the Bat Girl H-Scene!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/fb1e2e1efe6391ae0ff6b0bf8de1dcbb36c4823e.png[/img]

Maybe it was her shy behaviour or her thick thighs that made you let your guard down. Now she has overpowered you and she will ride you again and again until you've bred her, before drinking your blood to help her new offspring grow.

If you want to get exclusive access to view the full H-Scene CG sets before the game gets released, Patreon patrons from Succubus Slave tier and above get exclusive access to view them at their original resolution. You also get a copy of the game on itch.io and a free steam key!

Check out [url=https://patreon.com/monstergirlinvasion]patreon[/url]!

We will continue to post updates as we do things and we hope that you enjoy what we have so far!

___

[h1]Devlog from 7th December 2021[/h1]
Work continues on the game and our artists are creating amazing work for us at a great pace.

We have been working on implementing one of our latest monster girls "Arogane" the spider queen. Keep an eye out for her in creepy caves or you may end up being her next prisoner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/9944779ac464bba631d5778f8ee57d97156ec198.png[/img]

Maps are still heavily WIP but we have a good prototype basis of how we want the first continent and the surrounding areas to look. For now we are working on getting the underlying systems, scenes and dialogues up to scratch so that they are nice and snappy when we finally let players get their hands on the game.

The next step after getting the first handful of monster girls implemented solidly, will be adding the feature to recruit them!

You can recruit one monster girl of each type, once recruited they will join your party as a unique character with their own personality and skills. Some recruitable bosses will serve as  main characters for story purposes but you can happily go through the game using your favourite monster girls of any combination and achieve the same experience.

_____

[h1]Devlog from 5th December 2021[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/4dc5f44623249f5d4b84ea6d9ad5bb74eccebf48.png[/img]
As of today, our steam page is now live! We are so excited to see it out in the open and published in such a place. We will be participating in the steam early access scheme in order to let those who are interested and want to support us play the game as it is developed.

All patrons and buyers on Itch.io will get a free steam key so you can also redeem it there when we reach our first playable build.

We would really appreciate it if you can follow and wishlist, every little helps!

On another note, our artists have been hard at work and created some more fantastic characters for us. We now have the elusive bat girl and the seductive spider queen 'Arogane'. We cant wait to show them off!

_____

[h1]Devlog from 1st December 2021[/h1]

We have already received some amazing work from our Artists, enough to make a decent inspired start on the game and begin to flesh out the world.

Development has now properly begun, we are working on getting the base systems up and running correctly before moving on to the story and progression elements. As our artists complete more art and character designs for us, we will work on implementing these characters and their corresponding traits/skills.

The first task is for us to make the battle system work the way we want it to. Monster girls need to have the ability to tease and tempt the hero in different ways as well as attack him. Sometimes they may even interrupt the battle to make a sexual offer. Be warned that this will definitely end in your demise, so don't get too tempted by them! ;)

When losing a battle, who gets to violate him will depend on which monster gets the killing blow. We have it working in quite a wonky way right now, so it doesn't always seem accurate. We will need to refine it more before being fully satisfied with it.

Eventually we want to have the player be able to recruit monster girls they have fought with. They will join your party as a unique character, with their own personality, dialogue and skills. We hope that players will be able to mix and match them to suit their play style and also overcome challenges.

___


If you read this far, thank you so much for reading!
We will post updates to steam more regularly from now on, we can't wait to show off more of the game to you!
